title: DreamMusicForge Editorial Architecture
description: Output of the Editorial Architecture Engine (pipeline stage: Editorial Architecture) -- the last engine before a Provider-Specific Production Package is assembled. Designs shot timing, reveal timing, motif evolution, visual callbacks (expectation and payoff), emotional pacing, and the ending. Cross-references the paired Cinematic Architecture's shot list and the paired Musical Architecture's tempo_map.

edit_timeline.description: One cut per shot at minimum. order and start_time_seconds must be strictly increasing. Every shot_id in the paired Cinematic Architecture must be covered by at least one cut (checked by validate_against_cinematic_architecture).

shot_id.description: Must match a shots[].shot_id in the paired Cinematic Architecture.

linked_tempo_segment_id.description: Required when cut_on_beat is true. Must match a tempo_map[].segment_id in the paired Musical Architecture.

motif_evolution.description: Grouped by motif_id. Each motif must have at least 2 entries (a motif that never evolves is not editorial architecture), strictly increasing order within its group, first stage 'introduced', and a final stage of 'transformed' or 'resolved'.

visual_callbacks.description: Expectation-and-payoff pairs. payoff_cut_id must occur later in the edit_timeline than setup_cut_id.

explicit_statement_rationale.description: Required when type is 'resolution_stated' -- stating a resolution outright is the exception, not the default, under the v2 non-compulsion mission, so it must be a deliberate, justified choice.

contains.const: This kernel does not claim to guarantee any specific viewer belief, emotion, or decision.
